scenarios.name: nothing heard twice in hands-free: ends with a clear message, nothing left running
microphone permission denied: message shown, back to idle, typing works
network error while listening: one short retry, then one message, no restart loop
tab goes to the background while listening: listening stops
leaving the page while listening: recogniser stopped, nothing restarts
language changed while listening: no second recogniser, and the running one follows the new language
the recogniser refuses to start (already started elsewhere, or blocked): message, back to idle
the engine freezes after start (no result, no end, no error) for 60 seconds: a watchdog ends the round
scenarios.note: state after 60 s of silence from the engine = idle

scenarios.name: tapping the round button while listening stops it at once
a final result arriving after the person tapped stop is not lost and not sent twice
scenarios.note: sent 1 time(s) for one spoken question that the engine reported twice

scenarios.name: wake phrase with a failing network: gives up with a message after a few tries instead of retrying for ever
two answers started close together: only the newest is spoken (no overlapping speech)
